rows.action: host ONNX DAG execution / per-node Python dispatch
rows.why: FusionExecutor/profiled_backend and the packed ONNX model are absent from the supplied read-only tree; cannot be migrated or run here.
rows.next: obtain the upstream executor/model, lower all nodes, then remove the host loop

rows.action: one START + poll + output read per fused program
rows.why: W023 one-START/one-DONE plan; 68-node control test and real mixed chain pass.
rows.next: bind the real 68 programs and the missing outside nodes to one plan; host read only final outputs

rows.action: per-program input tensor upload to DDR
rows.why: Host packs and uploads every fused input at runtime.
rows.next: preload once before START; compiler must bind each node input to a preloaded DDR tensor

rows.action: per-program float/Q output download
rows.why: Host reads each program output and reloads it through the next upload.
rows.next: keep intermediates in DDR; host reads only final CASE outputs

rows.action: per-matrix row/column window choice
rows.why: choose_row_step/column_step decide M/N windows at runtime from DDR capacity.
rows.next: freeze windows in the static compiler; no runtime capacity probing

rows.action: A16/W7 packing and matrix queue descriptor emission
rows.why: Host produces tile bytes and 64-B queue descriptors for each call.
rows.next: compile descriptors offline (existing compile_pl_plans path) and bind concrete B addresses

rows.action: C48->INT64 output conversion
rows.why: unpack_c runs on host after each matrix read.
rows.next: PL layout/vector conversion, or bind C to a PL epilogue; do not change C48 semantics

rows.action: unfused INT16 matmul and dynamic W7 encoding
rows.why: Outside the 68 closed programs, host still decomposes INT16 and calls _encode.
rows.next: enumerate outside MatMul/Gemm nodes; lower to PL matrix + QDQ nodes

rows.action: nonmatrix operand write_words / scalar parameter copies
rows.why: Host writes nonmatrix operands and uses a host-side FP32 dedup table.
rows.next: describe copies as PL layout/move nodes; remove host SHA/dedup state

rows.action: resident matrix context/view round-robin
rows.why: matrix_index21/context21 select weights by Python state; not in the plan.
rows.next: bind a concrete weight id/address to every matrix node at compile time

rows.action: host cookie/epoch allocation and stale-completion checks
rows.why: cookie21 is host implicit state; V022 queue epochs depend on it.
rows.next: PL generation/epoch in the superplan header and per-node epoch; retire host cookie

rows.action: host parameter-generation re-check between calls
rows.why: W023 latches generation at START and checks it during fetch/dispatch/drain.
rows.next: bind the production generation (compiler currently emits 0=ignore)

rows.action: PS starts one program and polls per program
rows.why: W023 replaces per-program PS starts with one PL plan; PS only start/observe.
rows.next: wire the whole-case plan and IRQ; keep PS free of numerical control flow

rows.action: legacy 591 queues / 593 descriptors outside the 68 plans
rows.why: The outside DAG is not in the image and its exact node list is absent.
rows.next: recover upstream model/executor, lower outside ops, re-run coverage

rows.action: per-program matrix index lookup in PS
rows.why: PS scans 68 entries per start; no inter-program dependency is represented.
rows.next: remove per-program lookup; one superplan fetch covers all nodes

rows.action: offline plan compilation (allowed startup work)
rows.why: This is desired: host compiles before parameter load, not during inference.
rows.next: extend to whole CASE and liveness-safe arenas; keep numerical steps unchanged

rows.action: per-program temporary arena base
rows.why: temp_base=0x04000000+extent_bytes is per-program, not liveness-global; 36 ranges overlap at peak.
rows.next: global liveness allocator/relocator; reject unresolved overlaps

rows.action: per-program output/scratch address reuse
rows.why: 15 shared write spans, 4 output-address groups with 6/12/24 writers; only safe under host serialization.
rows.next: either keep a proven total order or relocate to disjoint arenas before parallel dispatch

rows.action: matrix queue copy from parameter to scratch by layout move
rows.why: The queue is emitted in the image then copied to 0x03000000 by a PL move; top sees only base/count.
rows.next: keep the PL move or emit the queue directly into a preloaded scratch region; do not let the host copy per program

rows.action: host scale/metadata reinterpretation after completion
rows.why: Host reloads scale from the parameter image and rebuilds Tensor objects.
rows.next: bind scale ids in the plan; host only reads final outputs for comparison

note: CANDIDATE_COVERED means the W023 candidate logic covers the control action, not that whole CASE is runnable. NOT_IMPLEMENTED means the upstream source/model is absent or the outside DAG is not lowered.
